name: Koukan Nikki Dai 2 Shou ~Seiya o Anata to~
original_name: こうかん日記 第２章 ～聖夜をあなたと～
source:
New love adventure takes place during winter. While at part-time job hero gets acquainted to different girls and by the Christmas Eve he can confess his feelings to one of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一段新的戀愛冒險在冬日展開。打工期間，主角結識了形形色色的女孩；到了平安夜，他可以向其中一人告白。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
